verdict.rationale: Runloop's Blueprints are documented as reusable template images. They can be built from a Dockerfile via `rli blueprint from-dockerfile`, and blueprints let you specify startup actions once and reuse them across Devboxes. Prebuilt public blueprints and snapshots provide further templating, so both custom templates and bring-your-own-container are covered by first-party docs. missing for 10: explicit evidence of pulling an existing prebuilt registry image (vs. building from a Dockerfile), depth on blueprint configuration options, independent/hands-on corroboration.
